hints.title: Level-by-Level Collection
hints.text: Traverse the perfect binary tree level by level, tracking the current depth level.

hints.title: Odd Level Node Values
hints.text: When the current depth is odd, collect the references to all nodes at this level and reverse their stored values.

hints.title: Two-Pointer In-Place Swap
hints.text: Use two pointers from both ends of the level node list to swap node values without altering tree pointers.

hints.title: Level-Order Odd Node Value Reversal Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Each node is visited once during queue traversal with symmetric value swaps at odd levels.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Restructuring child pointers breaks parent-child invariants and adds unnecessary complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Queue holds nodes at the widest tree level (up to n/2 nodes).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Swaps node values symmetrically across odd levels during level-order traversal.
